_doc: Spoken forms for zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural (see references/pronunciation.md). lexicon: whole-token respellings, case-sensitive. parts/acronyms: pieces of snake_case identifiers. patterns: [regex, replacement] applied first. reword: [regex, advice] for wordings the voice misreads and no respelling can fix (the same characters need the other reading elsewhere); pron_check reports each hit and the narration must be rewritten. approved: terms confirmed right as the voice reads them (by the user's ear, or by a second ASR when Whisper alone mishears) (pron_check reports them as OK, never respells them). Add an entry only after pron_check.py --asr shows the written form fails and the respelling passes.
patterns: (?<![执运进并银发旅步飞流实施推举])行(?=[宽数号首尾距])
(?:(?<=[每整几两多少逐按长短二三四五六七八九十百千万亿])|(?<=\d)|(?<=\d )|(?<=\d[KMG])|(?<=\d[KMG] ))行(?!为|动|驶|走|人(?!工)|李|星|政|者|销|军|刑|径|凶|踪|囊|装|使(?!用)|进(?!行)|程(?!序)|得通|不通)
reword: the voice reads 还给 as huán gěi (give back) every time. Meaning "also gave": write 还附带了 / 另外给了 / 也给出了. Meaning "give back": write 归还给 / 交还给
Edge says key as T or P in every take (six videos in a row). The attention key: write K (query 和 K 做点积). A dict, cache or sort key: write 键 / 缓存键 / 整数键. key stays on screen and in code
Whisper hears nightly as Natalie and no respelling passed (PR 50741 video, 2026-11-18). Say 每天夜里跑的 CI / 每晚跑的 CI; nightly stays on screen
GEMM1 is heard GAME 1 / GAM1 and no respelling passed (Kimi-K3 video PR 46392, 2026-11-18). Describe the field instead (两个通用的参数，一个叫 alpha，一个叫 clamp limit); the identifier stays on screen
Edge reads 放行 as fàng háng (hang_take WRONG in the PR 46654 video and again in custom allreduce ② on 2026-11-22). Write 才能过 / 才让通过 / 不再推迟; 放行 stays on screen

After custom the voice runs into allreduce: Whisper heard Custom Bowery Deuce / Boreduce / Ball Reduce / or Reduce for every spelling tried (allreduce, all reduce, All-Reduce, AllReduce; custom allreduce series, 2026-11-22). Say 自定义 allreduce; custom allreduce stays on screen

tones._doc: Tone-only polyphones that tone_take.py grades in the recorded take (respelling cannot fix them: no common single-reading homophone, and Edge rejects SSML). readings: tone -> pinyin. default: the tone meant unless the character sits inside one of words[tone]. controls: single-reading characters of each tone, same final where possible, swapped in to build same-line references. Add a character only after tone_take.py --calibrate judges its controls right in >= 90 % of cases.

切.reword: keep 切 right before its result or object (切开 / 切成 / 切到 / 按 token 切开); a clause-final 切 after 不 (也不切它) came out qiè: write 也不把它切开 or 也不拆分它
